title: Heterogeneous basis partial derivative
statement: Let $p$ assign a real parameter to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $S$ be a set of coordinates, and let $x$ assign a real number to each coordinate. The heterogeneous-basis partial derivative at $x$ is the cube partial derivative associated with $S$ at $x$, multiplied by the product over $i\in S$ of the bias scale factor at $p_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ assigns a real number to each coordinate
$f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
$x$ assigns a real number to each coordinate
caveat: The definition of the bias scale factor is not included in the supplied statement.
